                    Exercises

            58.1
                    Listen to these extracts from news broadcasts as many times as you need and:

                    5 The  head of NATO   in Europe        Major  Peter Alvin (23, has warned  that its military
                      equipment  is becoming  seriously outdated.

            98.2

              D65
                    Now  listen and check your answers. Then say the sentences aloud. Make sure you use a step-down at
                    the beginning of the added information and the same tone (either falling or fall-rising) in the added
                    information and the previous noun phrase.

            8.3
